title: FreeFormatter.com
content_html: This website is being retired. Apparently, paying ever-increasing hosting fees to maintain a fragile pile of code, fight constant technical problems, and cover every usable inch of the page with invasive advertising is no longer considered a particularly rewarding hobby. AI can now do most of what this site was created to do—faster, cheaper, and without demanding that I debug something at 2 a.m. because a dependency decided to reinvent itself. Meanwhile, ad networks have continued their noble mission of turning the internet into a flickering landfill of pop-ups, tracking scripts, fake download buttons, and cookie banners. So congratulations to everyone involved. The hosting companies got their money, the advertisers harvested their data, the maintenance backlog achieved immortality, and the open web became slightly worse. I’m done. Thanks to the actual humans who visited and supported the site. You were the only part of this that didn’t make me regret owning a computer.

content_html_zh: 该网站即将停用。 显然，支付不断增加的托管费用来维护脆弱的代码堆、解决不断的技术问题以及用侵入性广告覆盖页面的每一英寸可用的英寸不再被认为是特别有益的爱好。 现在，人工智能可以完成该网站创建的大部分任务——更快、更便宜，而且不需要我在凌晨 2 点调试某些内容。 因为依赖决定重塑自己。 与此同时，广告网络继续其崇高使命，将互联网变成一个充满弹出窗口、跟踪脚本、虚假下载按钮和 cookie 横幅的闪烁垃圾填埋场。 祝贺所有参与者。 托管公司得到了他们的钱，广告商收获了他们的数据，维护积压实现了不朽，开放网络变得稍微糟糕了。 我受够了。 感谢访问和支持该网站的实际人员。 你是这一切中唯一没有让我后悔拥有一台电脑的部分。
